pools[].username: SQLAlchemy reports no username when the configured URL has no user information
pools[].maximumPoolSize: SQLAlchemy has no fixed maximum for unlimited overflow or pools without a size
pools[].connectionTimeoutMs: SQLAlchemy pools without a checkout timeout do not expose this BootUI setting
pools[].minimumIdle: SQLAlchemy QueuePool does not expose a Hikari-style minimum idle setting
pools[].idleTimeoutMs: SQLAlchemy pool does not expose an idle timeout setting
pools[].maxLifetimeMs: SQLAlchemy pool does not expose a recycle setting when disabled
pools[].validationTimeoutMs: SQLAlchemy pool does not expose a validation timeout setting
pools[].keepaliveTimeMs: SQLAlchemy pool does not expose a keepalive setting
pools[].readOnly: SQLAlchemy pool does not expose a pool-level read-only flag
pools[].autoCommit: SQLAlchemy does not expose a boolean auto-commit setting outside AUTOCOMMIT isolation
pools[].snapshot.pending: SQLAlchemy QueuePool does not expose a pending checkout count
pools[].snapshot: SQLAlchemy pool implementations without counter statistics have no snapshot object
